Family Rooms & Private Group Stay in Rameswaram
sections.imageAlt: Joy AC Hall & Rooms in Rameswaram
sections.description:
**Joy AC Hall & Rooms** offers comfortable **AC family rooms and private group accommodation in Rameswaram**, located in Thangachimadam near Pamban Bridge. Our rooms are suitable for families and small groups of **4–10 guests**, while our private group stay is designed for larger groups of **15–70 guests**.

Whether you're visiting Rameswaram for a family trip, pilgrimage, or group tour, we provide a convenient and comfortable base for exploring **Pamban Bridge, Ramanathaswamy Temple, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial, Dhanushkodi** and other popular attractions.
